$comment: LitNode gauntlet config for Rapture Chess (node/gauntlet.js). For every rapture-chess.v1 match this node hosts, it spawns relay/server.mts for that match alone: the node mints the seat tickets, proxies wss://<wsAddr>/<room> to the process, and the process posts the signed ledger to the node's /ledger and exits. Copy this file, set cwd to your Rapture Chess checkout (pnpm install at its root), then in the node's environment: GAUNTLETS=rapture-chess.v1=<absolute path to your copy>, GAUNTLET_GATEWAY_PORT=8478 (or RELAY_PORT=8478 when no other title fronts a relay), RULESETS=<checkout>/rulesets/rapture-chess.v1.js. The GAUNTLET_* variables (match id, seed, seats, secret, port, node url, build, placed mode) are set by the node per match.
